boxes.question: Does the proposal use the title “Love Book Donation & Community Reading Day” and explain the activity’s background and significance, including relevance to national reading policies and resource sharing?
Does the proposal specify the activity’s time, location, and target participants?
Does the proposal cover a book donation area with classification standards, an interactive experience zone that includes a DIY bookmark workshop, and a publicity display area?
Does the proposal give a detailed process covering pre-event preparation, on-site implementation, and post-event follow-up?
Does the proposal provide promotion strategies for both online and offline channels?
Does the proposal include a budget estimate?
Does the proposal identify plausible risks and provide contingency plans for them?
Does the proposal describe specific innovative highlights of the activity?
